“废话少说，赶紧把人交出来！”这个话题不太好，于是有人将话题又绕回来正题上。

“人不是我抓的，不过……你们若是想知道是谁，我可以告诉你们哟。”时笙拖长了音，笑容满满的道。

“怎么可能不是你……”

“就是，除了你谁还会做这种事！”

这些人嘴上说着，但是脸上却有些狐疑，这件事到底如何，他们其实也不清楚，只是听龙玦和桐山派掌门在说……

叶清秋心底一沉，仰头看向时笙，时笙正看着她，脸上的笑容怎么看都觉得讽刺，偏生那双眼睛……平静得如同一潭死水。

这个女人，必须死！

“商殊，你还想挑拨我们吗？”叶清秋上前一步，“她在拖延时间，大家不要上当。”

经叶清秋这么一提醒，众人如梦初醒，不管这件事到底如何，她都做了那么多事，除掉她就是大功德一件。

但若是凤辞回来了……

那场面他们不敢想。

“我牵制住她，你们布阵。”龙玦飞身而上，朝着时笙攻击。

龙玦的修为比时笙高，时笙就算有着一身顶级装备，也不过只是保护自己不受伤，想要伤到龙玦却是不可能的。

而龙玦也没有尽力，他只是将时笙往院子中央逼。

时笙看出他的意图，哪里敢往院子去，眼看就要离开，叶清秋突然出现在她背后，一掌拍到她后背。

时笙一个踉跄，龙玦趁机打出一道劲风，将时笙掀到地面上。

落地的瞬间，像是触及到了什么，光芒大盛，将时笙笼罩了进去，外面人影晃动。

果然还是修为太低了。

时笙垂头看了眼身下条纹清晰，白光流动的阵法，略心塞。

她咬破手指，在空气中画了一个血符，脸色有些发白，但是眸子里却无半点惊慌，依旧是那般的平静。

画完最后一笔，光芒已经消失了，她能清晰的看到外面的人，外面的人也能清晰的看到她。

“那是什么？”桐山派掌门惊诧的看着浮在时笙面前的血符。

阵法中的女子，黑袍翻飞，一片肃杀中，她却安静得像是处于另外一个世界。她眼底的平静近似漠然，似乎他们做的这些，在她眼中，不过是一场可笑的独角戏。

时笙食指抬高，外面的人下意识的屏住呼吸。

“今日之事，诸位可记住了。”时笙的声音透过阵法传出来，有些破碎，他们却听得清清楚楚。

音落，她食指轻触那个血符，本是白色的阵法瞬间被染成了血红。

四周的景物在那一瞬间被模糊，黯淡，失去光彩，只剩下静立在红光中的黑袍女子，世间万物在那一瞬间寂静无声，似乎怕惊扰了她一般。

"Stop talking nonsense and hand over the person quickly!" This topic was not a good one, so someone brought the topic back to the main topic.

"I didn't capture the person, but...if you want to know who it is, I can tell you." Shi Sheng protracted and said with a smile.

"How could it not be you..."

"That's right, who would do such a thing except you!"

These people were talking, but there was some doubt on their faces. They actually didn't know what this matter was about. They just listened to what Long Jue and the leader of the Tongshan Sect were saying...

Ye Qingqiu's heart sank, and he looked up at Shi Sheng. Shi Sheng was looking at her. The smile on his face seemed ironic no matter how you looked at it, but those eyes... were as calm as a pool of stagnant water.

This woman must die!

"Shang Shu, do you still want to provoke us?" Ye Qingqiu took a step forward, "She is stalling for time, don't be fooled."

After Ye Qingqiu's reminder, everyone woke up from a dream. No matter what happened, she had done so many things, and getting rid of her would be a great merit.

But if Feng Ci comes back...

They didn't dare to think about that scene.

"I'll hold her down while you set up your formation." Long Jue flew up and attacked Shi Sheng.

Long Jue's cultivation level was higher than that of Shi Sheng. Even if Shi Sheng had top-notch equipment, it could only protect herself from getting hurt. It was impossible to hurt Long Jue.

And Long Jue didn't try his best. He just forced Shi Sheng towards the center of the courtyard.

Shi Sheng saw his intention and dared to go to the yard. Just as she was about to leave, Ye Qingqiu suddenly appeared behind her and slapped her on the back.

Shi Sheng stumbled, and Long Jue took the opportunity to blast out a strong wind, knocking Shi Sheng to the ground.

The moment he landed, he seemed to have touched something. The light shone brightly and enveloped Shi Sheng. The figures outside were shaking.

Sure enough, his cultivation level is still too low.

Shi Sheng lowered his head and looked at the formation with clear stripes and flowing white light under his body, feeling a little heartbroken.

She bit her finger and drew a blood talisman in the air. Her face turned a little pale, but there was no trace of panic in her eyes, and she was still so calm.

After finishing the last stroke, the light had disappeared. She could clearly see the people outside, and the people outside could also clearly see her.

"What is that?" The leader of Tongshan Sect looked at the blood talisman floating in front of Shi Sheng in surprise.

The woman in the formation, her black robe flying, was in a state of solemnity, but she was as quiet as if she was in another world.The calmness in her eyes was almost indifferent, as if what they were doing was just a ridiculous one-man show in her eyes.

Shi Sheng raised his index finger, and the people outside subconsciously held their breath.

"Please remember what happened today." Shi Sheng's voice came out through the formation. It was a little broken, but they could hear it clearly.

As soon as the sound fell, she touched the blood talisman lightly with her index finger, and the originally white formation was instantly dyed blood red.

The surrounding scenery was blurred, dimmed, and lost its luster at that moment, leaving only the black-robed woman standing quietly in the red light. Everything in the world was silent at that moment, as if they were afraid of disturbing her.
